en: A black and white image of a grand historical building with ornate facades and a domed corner tower labeled 'MERKUR.' The building fronts a tree-lined boulevard, and in the foreground is a decorative wrought-iron bridge crossing a shallow river. Several street signs are visible, as well as a building in the background with the words 'AUTOMOBIL' and 'MERCUR.' The overall atmosphere suggests a prosperous, late 19th to early 20th-century European spa or resort town.
